newsitem.title: TANZANIA: President asked to free Tanzanian journalist.
newsitem.headline: President asked to free Tanzanian journalist.

text.p: A Tanzanian journalists' association has asked President Benjamin Mkapa to quash a one-year jail sentence for a journalist found guilty of breaching national security laws.
"What the president can do is ask those involved in the justice to see if this is correct," said Presidential Spokesman Patrick Chokola on Saturday of the case against Adam Mwaibabile.
The freelance journalist, based in the southern region of Songea, was jailed last week for a year for possessing what was described as a secret government document. He was arrested last April.

The Tanzania Association of Journalists and Media Workers said the document was a letter intercepted by Mwaibabile from a regional commissioner to the Songea town director, telling him to deny the journalist a licence to operate a stationery shop.
The association said Mwaibabile, 31, was arrested and jailed for his writing against corrupt politicians and administrators.
